HarnessWorkspace.StageRoutesHelp: Use Default for ordinary work, Judgment for advisory evaluations, or an exact orchestration stage key. Saving approves these provider/model pairs, and their fallbacks, for this installation. Fallbacks are tried in order only when the previous target is unavailable before any output; each attempt is reserved against the task budget at its own price.
HarnessWorkspace.JudgmentsHelp: Configure a Judgment route to enable bounded evaluations. Code supplies the allowed choices; the platform rejects answers outside that set. Judgments are recorded with model usage and never approve operations or expand capabilities.
HarnessWorkspace.JudgeGrantNote: Agents with the explicit {grant} grant can request an evaluation through their platform tools. The selected model uses the same provider authorization and task budget as other inference.
